title: Trusted Partner Program - Industry Day Notification
agency_path: DEPT OF DEFENSE.DEPT OF THE ARMY.AMC.ACC.ACC-CTRS.ACC-APG.W6QK ACC-APG DURHAM
detail_text: INDUSTRY DAY NOTICE (FOR TPP): The Army Contracting Command - Research Triangle Park Division along with the U.S. Army Combat Capabilities Development Command (DEVCOM), Army Research Office (ARO) cordially invites you to our upcoming Industry Day event held on 07 May 2026 from 09:30 AM to 11:30 AM EST in support of the posted, draft solicitation for the Trusted Partner Program as provided under: https://sam.gov/workspace/contract/opp/629e0be660b043b99a133e3a3ca37147/view This virtual event offers potential industry partners in Higher Education and their Associated Entities, as well as Non-Profit Research Institutes and Federally Funded Research and Development Centers an opportunity to support projects at all security levels, including Controlled Unclassified Information, Secret, and Top Secret and to manage research spanning Technology Readiness Levels (from fundamental discovery to advanced technology development) to rapidly initiate and execute sensitive, basic, and applied research projects across a wide range of scientific disciplines critical to Army needs. Please click on the following registration link and click “START NOW” to register: https://forms.osi.apps.mil/r/Myd4KLcSQQ * Registration Deadline: 4:00PM EST, Wednesday 06 May 2026* To participate in the Industry Day event, click on the following link to join: https://dod.teams.microsoft.us/l/meetup-join/19%3adod%3ameeting_ac4e21512f844cb39ab79de0cd9ad3a4%40thread.v2/0?context=%7B%22Tid%22%3A%22fae6d70f-954b-4811-92b6-0530d6f84c43%22%2C%22Oid%22%3A%229241d0f7-5a97-4565-bef1-9d38d2159ca7%22%2C%22IsBroadcastMeeting%22%3Atrue%2C%22role%22%3A%22a%22%7D&btype=a&role=a There will also be an opportunity for one-on-one sessions, so please sign up at the link below if you are interested: Industry Day One-on-Ones : (30 minutes) Click Link to Sign Up: https://webmail.apps.mil/book/DEVCOMAROTPPdraftRFP-Bookings@army.mil/s/OgD3AOTq7ES0NK3t12XAog2?ismsaljsauthenabled Thursday, May 7th, 2026: 1200 - 1500 EST Friday, May 8th, 2026: 0900 - 1700 EST Monday, May 11th, 2026: 0900 - 1700 EST *** PLEASE NOTE: ATTACHMENT WILL HAVE EMBEDDED LINKS ***
